turns.replyTail: Jen Small: You can track your return using the tracking number on the return label emailed when you started the return. You can also check the status by chatting with Jen Small; please have your order ID and the same email address used for the order ready. Once delivered, returns take up to 3–5 working days to process. A refund to your original payment method may then take up to 7 business days to appear, depending on your bank. You can review the return, refund, or store credit status details.
